risks.description: KMP scope expanding into UI, networking, or persistence, leading to brittle cross-platform bridges.
risks.mitigation: Enforced Ponytail guardrail: mobile/shared is strictly standard-library only. Any PR adding external dependencies to shared is automatically rejected.
risks.trigger: Attempted addition of Ktor, SQLDelight, or Compose Multiplatform to shared/build.gradle.kts

risks.description: One platform becoming a superficial visual port of the other, violating native platform idioms.
risks.mitigation: Parallel execution model (M2, M3, M4). Android uses Material 3 Expressive, iOS uses HIG. Semantic parity enforced; visual divergence explicitly allowed.
risks.trigger: Attempting to copy SwiftUI component structures into Compose or vice-versa

risks.description: Presenting scheduled timetable bus data as live vehicle tracking or fabricating missing fares.
risks.mitigation: Truth Contracts document. Badges must be derived from DataProvenance enums. 'Scheduled' label mandatory. Fares strictly null until audited table ingested.
risks.trigger: UI using the phrase 'live arrival' or displaying a moving bus icon without telemetry

risks.description: Accidentally introducing paid runtime routing or places autocomplete APIs, creating high ongoing operational costs.
risks.mitigation: Zero-cost external navigation handoff strategy using Google Maps / Apple Maps universal URLs ($0.00 cost). Unlimited free mobile SDK map loads.
risks.trigger: Attempt to add Google Routes API or Places Autocomplete SDK to mobile projects

risks.description: Bumping iOS deployment target to iOS 18+ for visual effects, breaking compatibility with older active devices.
risks.mitigation: Strict policy: iOS 17.0+ minimum. Liquid Glass is progressive enhancement behind #available(iOS 18, *) checks. Never fake in software.
